name: sap-emarsys
_readme: SAP Emarsys as a TARGET only: multi-tenant SaaS customer engagement platform (contacts, segments, Automation Center programs, email / mobile / web / SMS / wallet / ads / direct mail channels, Brand Center content, Web Extend + Predict, Smart Insight on sales data, Loyalty module, Engagement Events). Product name on help.sap.com as of 2026-10-05: 'SAP Engagement Cloud | SAP Emarsys' (short 'SAP Emarsys'); dev.emarsys.com still says 'SAP Emarsys Customer Engagement Platform' - the same product, see aliases. Built for brownfield extension estimates (a client already runs one account / country and adds countries, brands, channels and triggered journeys) and for the standard critic `standard-sap-emarsys`. No code base to scan: no as_source block, no adapter.py. Verified facts: reference-cache.md (2026-10-05, verbatim quotes); open points: research-seed.md *(verify)*. The Loyalty module is context only - a separate loyalty pack covers it.

as_target.api_name: SAP Emarsys Core API v3 (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC)
as_target.default_frontend: none - SAP Emarsys renders the messages itself (email, push, in-app, web channel overlays and embeds, SMS); the client's shop or app integrates through Web Extend, the mobile SDKs and the APIs

snippets.critic2_persona: seasoned SAP Emarsys solution architect and onboarding lead who has rolled out multi-country, multi-brand Emarsys estates (several accounts per country or brand, distributed program templates, CDC / CDP / Commerce Cloud connectors) and who challenges every 'this is standard' claim: which product package licenses it (Core, E-Commerce Accelerator with Smart Insight and full Predict, Loyalty Module, Mobile app marketing option, Account Engagement option, Advanced Integration Capabilities, additional account, test tenant), whether it is generally available or still Pilot / Early Adopter (Brand Center, Design Themes, Universal Schema Builder, Localized Product Personalization, the Engagement Cloud SDK), whether the mechanism exists for THIS account (External Events and Google Pub/Sub only for clients who started before January 2026 and the External event trigger source being deprecated from Q2 2026; Engagement Events for everyone else), which switches only SAP Support can set (transactional opt-in, account connections for distribution, extra loyalty plans, indexed key fields), which data must exist before a journey can fire (identifiable contact, event type, Web Extend tracking, product catalog, sales data), what is configuration in the UI versus integration work in the client's systems, and what a new account means: provisioning, domains and DNS, ramp-up, users and roles, field set, consent, connectors, data feeds and content - distribution copies programs, not the setup
snippets.docs_domains: help.sap.com (product SAP_EMARSYS, version CLOUD: Application Help, Getting Started, Integration Guide, Support Center, Add-ons, and the legally binding Feature Scope Description for SAP Emarsys) - a JS application that answers HTTP 200 for any URL: read pages only through the content service (the sap-commerce pack's tools work for any help.sap.com product and need no run: `python3 <plugin>/knowledge/platforms/sap-commerce/tools/saphelp.py <topic-url>` prints the topic as text, `python3 <plugin>/knowledge/platforms/sap-commerce/tools/sapsearch.py "<query>" SAP_EMARSYS` searches the portal - generic queries only; the quote gate reads the same content service); dev.emarsys.com (official SAP Emarsys Developer Hub: Core API guides and reference, Loyalty API v4, Vouchers API, SMS API, Web Extend reference, changelog - a Stoplight single-page app, plain HTTP returns only a shell: read it in a (headless) browser); help.emarsys.com is the legacy help centre, bot-protected - cite help.sap.com instead; github.com/emartech (official SDKs: engagement-cloud-sdk, android-emarsys-sdk, ios-emarsys-sdk, react-native-emarsys-sdk; Postman collection). Product names shift (Emarsys, SAP Emarsys Customer Engagement, SAP Engagement Cloud | SAP Emarsys): cite the current page title, never a remembered name.
snippets.best_practice: identify contacts by a stable unique external identifier (custom field named exactly externalId, indexed when used as key) rather than by email - and on mobile the external ID is the only option; keep marketing consent in the standard opt-in field (system field 31: 1 / 2 / empty, set TRUE only via double opt-in) and let one system master it; build triggered journeys as Event-based Automation programs on one well-defined event per use case (Engagement Event for new set-ups - External Events are closed to new clients and their trigger source is being deprecated; connector events from SAP Commerce Cloud, Shopify, Adobe Commerce; Web Extend; Mobile; Product Catalog Updates; Wishlist) with event_time, deduplication ids and a trigger event timeout; remember that Event-based Automation sends through Triggered Email mail streams that ignore opt-in, so put a Decision node on opt-in before every marketing email; carry transactional data in the event payload (EBA triggers only below 20 kB of event data, max 100 items in foreach) and build the message in the Visual Content Editor with language versions keyed by the IETF language tag field; start from the shipped Tactics before building from scratch; open a separate account per country or brand only when sender identity, data separation, users, loyalty plans or billing require it, then build programs and content once in a repository or staging account and distribute copies (bulk up to 15 programs, custom fields up to 100 at once) and fix what distribution does not carry; test with the program test mode and test events, a Sandbox tenant for integration work (no email sending there), and draft endpoints for engagement event types; move WSSE API credentials to OAuth 2.0 (v3, OIDC) before the WSSE sunset; use sender subdomains of the brand domain with SPF / DKIM / DMARC (p=reject) / MX, a separate link domain, a separate transactional sender domain, and do not split domains below roughly 40-50k emails per month.
snippets.critic2_focus: D1: current product name and the package that licenses each capability; GA versus Pilot / Early Adopter status; deprecations (WSSE API authentication sunset end of 2026 / EOL 1 Feb 2027, External Events closed to new clients since January 2026 and the External event trigger source deprecated incrementally from Q2 2026, Event Monitoring replaced by the Integration Monitor, Get response summary endpoint, APNS Safari push, retired dashboards); published limits (1000 Core API requests per minute per API credential, OAuth token fetch 50 / min per client, 1000 contacts or event objects per batch call, 8-10 MB contact payload, 1 MB external-event payload but EBA triggers only below 20 kB, 50 EBA trigger events per second per account, Engagement Events 200 kB payload / 5000 calls per minute / 200 event types, Product Catalog API 100 items or 9 MB per request). D2: is the 'standard' counterpart a configurable feature, a Tactic, a connector (SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP Customer Data Cloud, SAP Customer Data Platform, SAP Sales Cloud Version 1, Shopify, Adobe Commerce), an add-on, a Support-only switch or custom integration in the client's systems. D3: covered-standard only when the feature is GA and licensed for this account, the needed data already flows (events, products, sales data, consent) and the channel is set up in the target account (domains, sender, SDK, Web Extend, Predict); a new country or brand account repeats setup work even when programs are distributed. D4: exact trigger / entry-point names, API endpoint paths (/api/v3/...), event payload shape and identifier, connector limits (one Commerce Cloud Backoffice per Emarsys account, customerID as fixed identifier, unchangeable field mapping, real-time events for logged-in users only, product sync in one language and one currency, no product deletion) and what distribution does NOT copy (contact lists, relational segments, API nodes, Custom HTML / VCMS campaigns, triggered-email sender domain, repeatable blocks, personalization fields; VCE campaigns stay bound to the source template; programs with an Engagement Event trigger are not on the supported list).
snippets.expected_hotspots_d3: new country or brand: separate account (tenant) versus one shared account (VCE language versions, brand / country segments, consents per brand mapped from CDC / CDP, multiple SMS short codes); sender and link domains, DNS, Support ticket and 1-4 weeks of reputation building; users / roles / SSO across accounts; field set and distribution of programs and content; one Predict account and one Web Extend merchant per Emarsys account; triggered journeys whose events do not exist yet (order, shipment, back-in-stock, price drop, service or loyalty events) - the event source must be built or switched on before a program can fire; consent and double opt-in across CDC / CDP / Commerce Cloud / Emarsys (which system masters opt-in; Triggered Email ignores opt-in; multi-language DOI needs the Client Success Manager); transactional emails with rich payloads (order lines, attachments - attachments only via Triggered Email); product recommendations (Web Extend, product catalog with localized fields, Recommendation Center); Smart Insight and RFM segmentation (daily sales data, E-Commerce Accelerator package); B2B requirements (Account Engagement option, corporate accounts, on-behalf emails, Sales Cloud Version 1 or the Corporate Account API); cross-account reporting (unified dashboard); data residency (no general hosting-location statement found; Open Data EU-only on Google Cloud, Predict on AWS) and the data processing agreement
snippets.expected_blockers_d4: the account generation: External Events and Google Pub/Sub events are only available to clients who started before January 2026 and the External event trigger source is being deprecated from Q2 2026 - a new journey or a new account should be planned on Engagement Events (integration + event type + generated endpoint per type; existing contacts only, no contact creation); per-account setup that distribution cannot copy (contact lists, relational segments, API nodes, Custom HTML / VCMS campaigns, triggered-email sender domain, repeatable blocks; account connections for distribution are set up by Support; programs with an Engagement Event trigger are not listed as distributable); the SAP Commerce Cloud connector links one Commerce Backoffice to one Emarsys account, uses customerID as fixed identifier with an unchangeable field mapping (extra fields only via a ticket for all customers), sends real-time events for logged-in users only, syncs products in one language and one currency, never deletes products, needs the Integration API extensions, ImpEx files, IP allow-listing and maintenance after Commerce upgrades from 2211.28; CDC / CDP connectors need 'Try to Match by Email' before activation and filtering rules per account (contacts that leave a filter must be deleted manually); full Predict and Smart Insight need the E-Commerce Accelerator package, Loyalty needs Smart Insight; Sandbox and test tenants cannot send email and get no sender domains, so end-to-end email tests need a productive account; WSSE credentials must move to OAuth 2.0 before the sunset; limits (1000 API requests per minute per credential, 50 EBA trigger events per second, 20 kB EBA event data, batch size 1000) shape bulk and real-time integrations
snippets.content_model_notes: SAP Emarsys content is built in its own editors, not in a CMS: the Visual Content Editor (VCE, block-based email campaigns and templates with template variables, editable and optional content, multi-language versions keyed by the IETF language tag and a master language as fallback, block targeting, Campaign Update to push template changes) or the HTML editor; Web Channel campaigns (overlay, embedded, ribbon); Mobile Engage push / in-app / inbox messages; Web Push; SMS / MMS; WhatsApp / LINE via Sinch; Mobile Wallet passes; Omnichannel Voucher; personalization tokens (contact data, external data from event payloads, external content, relational data, Predict, voucher, loyalty) and the SAP Engagement Cloud Scripting Language (ESL). Brand Center (omnichannel content blocks, design themes, branded blocks) was Early Adopter at reading time and covers Web Channel and in-app, not email - never count it as standard email branding. Email templates can be ordered from SAP (designs as .psd / .html, max 650 px, translatable strings listed for multi-language); a new brand usually needs its own template. Distribution copies block-based campaigns and templates (campaigns stay bound to the source template unless it is copied) and Web Channel content blocks; images and link domains stay those of the source account. Multi-language pitfalls: unsubscribe / online-version links and voucher pools do not follow the language version. Estimate content per brand x language x channel.
snippets.api_families_hint: see knowledge target_api_endpoint_families - Core API v3 at https://api.emarsys.net/api/v3 (OAuth 2.0 client credentials, token endpoint https://auth.emarsys.net/oauth2/token; the WSSE-based v2 authentication is being sunset); endpoint permissions are partly off by default per API credential; Loyalty API v4 at contact-api.loyalsys.io; SMS API; Web Extend JavaScript data collection; mobile SDKs; Engagement Events generate one ingestion endpoint per event type; Product Catalog Stream API; Sales Data API; Corporate Account API (B2B)
snippets.effort_rules: TRIGGERED JOURNEY (reusable estimation pattern, per journey and account): (1) event - reusing a shipped connector event (SAP Commerce Cloud real-time events, Shopify / Adobe Commerce events, Web Extend, Mobile, Wishlist, Product Catalog Updates) is configuration; a new Engagement Event (integration + event type with contact-matching field, dedup id, retention; draft endpoint for testing) is small configuration in Emarsys, BUT the sending side (shop, ERP, middleware or Integration Suite flow - for SAP Commerce Cloud integration object, consumed destination, OAuth credential, webhook or outbound channel) is integration work sized separately; External Events only for pre-2026 accounts and on a deprecation path; (2) data - the contact must already exist and be identifiable (externalId / customerID), consent fields set, payload fields defined (EBA triggers only below 20 kB of event data), product / sales data present if personalised; (3) audience logic - segments, Decision on opt-in (Triggered Email ignores opt-in), Participation check, trigger event timeout; (4) content - a VCE campaign per language from an existing brand template is small, a new template or brand is medium to large; tokens and ESL loops for payload items (max 100); (5) program - Event-based Automation program (one trigger per program), start from a Tactic where one fits (SAP Commerce Cloud tactics: welcome, order confirmation, fulfilment update, reviews, post-purchase, real-time abandoned cart); (6) testing - program test mode with test events and test contacts, inbox preview, end-to-end with the source system in an account that can send email (a Sandbox cannot); (7) go-live - activation, monitoring (Integration Monitor), fail-safe handling. A journey whose event already flows is mostly configuration + content; a journey whose event does not exist is dominated by the source-system integration. NEW ACCOUNT for a country or brand: provisioning via SAP for Me, account owner, users / roles / SSO, permitted domains, IP access, API credentials with endpoint permissions, sender + link (+ transactional) domains and DNS (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX), Support ticket for domain activation and 1-4 weeks of reputation building / warm-up (onboarding guide: 30 days for core + email only, up to 90 days for advanced packages), Web Extend / SDK and Predict per account, field set (distribute up to 100 custom fields), connectors configured per account (CDC / CDP filter rules and consent mapping, Commerce Cloud connection - one Backoffice per account), content templates, then bulk-distribute programs (15 at once; above 50 segments distribute the framework only) and fix what distribution does not carry.
